Compliance Objective: Prevent intentional or accidental leaks of patient data to public foundation models
Mitigation/Control: Deploy models in a private cloud environment, use dedicated private endpoints, or enforce verified Zero Data Retention (ZDR) APIs with signed Business Associate Agreements (BAAs)

Compliance Objective: Ensure patient identifiers are thoroughly removed before sending unstructured notes to a model
Mitigation/Control: Integrate a local or self-hosted clinical Named Entity Recognition (NER) pipeline to scrub or mask the 18 HIPAA identifiers before model inference

Compliance Objective: Protect patients from diagnostic or treatment recommendations caused by AI hallucinations
Mitigation/Control: Mandate a clinical 'Human-in-the-loop' workflow where a licensed practitioner reviews, edits, and signs off on all AI-generated medical summaries or draft charts before they enter the EHR

Compliance Objective: Retain a historical record of AI-driven medical decisions for compliance and liability reviews
Mitigation/Control: Implement immutable application logs that capture the prompt version, system instructions, temperature setting, underlying data used, and the generated output
